verdict.rationale: The only pricing-related evidence is the llms.txt probe, which says SigNoz Cloud uses "simple usage-base[d]" pricing. That hints at a transparent self-serve model but shows no actual per-signal rates. The free self-hosted open-source option is noted, but it does not support predicting cloud costs. Missing for 10: published per-signal prices (per GB of logs/traces, per million metric samples), a pricing calculator or cost-estimation docs, confirmation that no sales contact is needed, and any independent corroboration that costs are predictable.
